title: H0809 (2020 Regular): Licenses to Carry Concealed Weapons or Firearms

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Florida); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Florida text (Introduced, 2019-11-26; official copy, https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2020/809/BillText/Filed/PDF (LegiScan doc 2070948))

operative_text:
Section 1 (s. 790.06, F.S.): Such licenses shall be valid throughout the state for a period of 5 years from the date of issuance.
Section 1 (s. 790.06(5)(b), F.S.): A nonrefundable license fee of up to $40 if he or she has not previously been issued a statewide license or of up to $35 for renewal of a statewide license.
Section 1 (s. 790.06(5)(c), F.S.): Fingerprints shall be retained in the statewide automated biometric identification system under s. 943.05(2)(b) and when available, the national retained print arrest notification program under s. 943.05(4).
Section 1 (s. 790.06(11)(b), F.S.): Upon each renewal, a licensee must provide proof of completion of a firearms training or safety course or class at least 8 hours in length taught by a state, county, or municipal law enforcement agency or a nationally recognized organization that promotes gun safety.
